label: SCG I.22 necessary esse isolates conjunction contingency
meaning: Non-transcription structural consequence in a typed analyst profile: necessity of esse is separately quantified from contingent joining to q. The failed conjunction does not entail the failure of the esse; the no-necessity control shows the necessity condition matters. 'Same esse' is a structural surrogate: the same represented esse principle satisfies the esse-existence predicate at the counterworld; bearer existence, q.3 actuality and q's existence there are not tracked. No attributed historical claim or metaphysical establishment is involved.
